Risk: AI-агенты путают репозитории разных контекстов. ~/projects/ai-platform/ — платформа (общий инструмент). ~/projects/hermes-agent/ — базовый образ агента. ~/projects/<org>/hermes-agent/ — контекстный оверлей агента. ~/projects/<org>/node-configs/ — конфигурация узлов контекста. ~/projects/<org>/<project>/ — проекты контекста. title: AI-Platform Declaration
description: Schema for ai-platform.yaml — единый манифест проекта AI Platform (деплой + мониторинг). ЕДИНСТВЕННЫЙ формат манифеста — AD-2.

name.description: Project name — alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only

type.description: Project category (frontend|backend) — agent is a platform component, not a project type (AD-1)

target_node.description: Target node name for deployment (matches node-configs)

platform_services.description: Platform service versions required by this project — MUST be pinned in semver format (04 §5)

additionalProperties.description: Semver string (e.g. '1.3.0' or '15.2') — 'latest' or empty rejected

platform_domain.description: Platform root domain for auto-generated project domains — project FQDN = <name>.<platform_domain>. Use __PLATFORM_DOMAIN__ placeholder in templates.

needs.description: Project resource needs declared to the platform (00 §5)

oneOf.description: Template placeholder — replaced by add-project.sh with auto-domain <name>.<platform_domain>
FQDN — must be a valid domain name (e.g. 'example.com')

domain.description: FQDN — first claimant owns it; conflict blocks deploy (06 §5.4 E1)

llm.description: LLM (LiteLLM) gateway configuration — progressive disclosure: enabled → profile → overrides

enabled.description: Enable LLM access via LiteLLM gateway

profile.description: Access profile from LLM policy — defines models, budget, rate limits

overrides.description: Per-project overrides on top of the assigned profile

node.description: Deprecated alias for target_node — use target_node

modules.description: Module names required by this project

env.description: Environment variables passed to the project (non-secret)

secrets_ref.description: Keys from decrypted secrets to inject as env vars

monitoring.description: Per-project monitoring configuration — all fields are optional; falls back to L1 defaults → L2 org overrides

ai_retention.description: Langfuse trace retention (active when project uses LiteLLM gateway)

alerting.description: Enable standard alerts (container down, OOM, errors)

dashboard.description: Auto-provision Grafana dashboard for this project

metrics_port.description: Prometheus metrics port (DevPlan 141: backend=8000 FastAPI, frontend=80 nginx)

host_port.description: Optional host port for port conflict validation
